factions.name: Umbral Vanguard
factions.description: Elite planar containment forces tasked with stabilizing void resonance and preventing planar collapse.

factions.name: Akhevan Dominion
factions.description: The primary Akhevan power on Luclin, seeking to weaponize void resonance and shadow energy.

factions.name: Shadow Anomalies

factions.name: Voidborn Entities
